explication: RiPlay is an Android music player for online and offline listening. The main user journey is to open the app, choose music, and play it through the playback service; online video playback uses the YouTube Player library, while the app also supports casting. The repository tree and README document broader capabilities such as recommendations, lyrics, recognition, customization, and backup. Some of those branches are represented at their listed paths, but wiring is omitted where sampled source does not establish it.
